responsibility: Defines the additional cp-specific tree codes used by the C++ front end beyond generic GCC tree.def. It is the canonical inventory and structural documentation for C++ AST node kinds such as member references, templates, constraints, coroutines, contracts, and other language-specific expressions/statements/types, enabling consistent tree-code generation and interpretation across parsing, semantics, dumping, and GC metadata.
same_name_distinction: This is the canonical list of cp-specific tree codes and their operand layouts/documentation, defining node kinds such as PRECONDITION_STMT, REQUIRES_EXPR, and CO_AWAIT_EXPR. Unlike cp-tree.h, it does not provide broad APIs or accessors for the C++ front end; it supplies the inventory of extra AST codes themselves.
